_source: Watched in the built-in browser 2026-11-24: frames at 0, ~2, then every 5-15 s, audio probe on two. Our own descriptions; shots approximate; words not counted (no transcript), so words are 0.

hook.firstFrame: relief map of South Asia with India painted one flat ochre colour

shots.picture: India in one flat colour on a relief base map
camera pushes into Punjab, painted orange with a white uppercase label
old undivided province painted crimson over the region
partition line splits the province; small figures pin the moving people
Indian side repainted, big year label and a round flag sticker
three new states painted in three colours with labels and the flag sticker

lines.gist: asks whether you know Punjab was once much bigger
the partition line cuts it in two
the Indian half is split again in 1966
three states come out of one; which is yours

ending.lastFrame: the region with three newly coloured states

whyItWorks: the map itself changes on every sentence: paint, split, repaint
a big year label lands on the key date
a sensitive story told as dates and lines, not blame
